input.question:
How many transaction entries occur across all blocks in the last 1 hours on chain 4663?
window: The observation covers the last 1 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
source: Use JSON-RPC at https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com for chain 4663; verify eth_chainId.
metric: Sum transactions.length from every eth_getBlockByNumber(number,false) result. Include reverted and system transactions if present in this array; count entries, not unique senders.
